title: AutoNinja - Website Design for an AI Automation Company
description:
AutoNinja needed a website that could do something most SaaS sites don't have to: sell a technical product to a non-technical buyer, and prove it works before the first sales call ever happened.

We designed and built an 8–9 section landing page (plus supporting pages) structured around a single conversion path — walking a skeptical visitor from problem ("the hidden cost of manual work"), to proof (a live agent catalogue with concrete time-saved numbers). Every section funnels toward the same outcome: a booked call.

The real challenge wasn't visual, it was translation. Concepts like agent routing, follow-up sequencing, and CRM integration had to be explained in language a founder could act on in under a minute, without flattening the product into vague marketing fluff that technical buyers would see straight through.

title: AutoNinja - Brand Identity for an AI Automation Company
description:
AutoNinja builds custom AI agents that handle lead response, follow-up, onboarding and support for growing businesses. The catch: a company selling automation can't launch looking slow or generic, the brand had to prove the pitch before the product even spoke.

We developed AutoNinja's full visual identity from scratch: logo, color system, typography and social kit - designed to read as "built by people who automate for a living." Every decision had to reinforce one idea: this company moves fast and builds things that actually work.

The identity needed to do double duty: feel credible to non-technical business owners while still signalling technical competence to more sophisticated buyers. No decoration for its own sake, every mark, colour, and type choice earns its place by building trust fast.
